from pathlib import Path
prog_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference/play/users/u073/system/state/workspace/programs')
prog_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for ny, nx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and grid[ny][nx] != 0 and (ny,nx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((ny,nx))
                        q.append((ny,nx))
            counts = Counter(grid[y][x] for y, x in cells)
            layers = [color for color, _ in counts.most_common()]
            mapping = dict(zip(layers, reversed(layers)))
            for y, x in cells:
                out[y][x] = mapping[grid[y][x]]
    return out
'''
p=prog_dir/'task-cbbd12dd.py'; p.write_text(code)
